# Zain Ul Abdin

> Growth marketing specialist for SaaS and service businesses. SEO, Reddit marketing, social media management, Google and Meta ads, and content and design — planned and executed by one person instead of a team of specialists.

Zain Ul Abdin is a growth marketing specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan, working with SaaS, AI, technology, home services and ecommerce companies across the US, UAE and Europe. His approach: diagnose the single constraint actually blocking growth before recommending any tactic, then execute the fix himself rather than handing off a strategy deck. Selected results include taking Blainy from 0 to 85,000+ users with no paid acquisition (~30M search impressions, 3.9M+ Instagram views), and driving 160,000+ Facebook views in 28 days for Everdry Waterproofing.

## Services

- [Growth strategy and GTM](https://www.zainameen.com/services/growth-strategy): Growth audits and go-to-market planning that find the real bottleneck across positioning, offer, acquisition, conversion, activation and retention before recommending anything. Audits from $499; ongoing execution from $3,999/month.
- [SEO](https://www.zainameen.com/services/seo): Search strategy, technical SEO, content and on-page work, authority building, and AI search visibility (GEO) for ChatGPT/AI Overviews. $1,999/month.
- [Reddit marketing](https://www.zainameen.com/services/reddit-marketing): Organic Reddit community marketing — research, real accounts, useful posts and threads that keep surfacing in Google and AI answers, without paid ads. $1,199/month.
- [Social media management](https://www.zainameen.com/services/social-media-management): Strategy, content, creative and community distribution across social platforms. From $1,199/month.
- [Google and Meta ads](https://www.zainameen.com/services/google-meta-ads): Paid acquisition management with tracking fixed first and landing pages optimized before spend scales. $1,499/month.
